desc: Derive exact local equations for A and B cells (A: top xor bottom = 1, left xor right = 1; B: top xor bottom = 0, left xor right = 0, top xor left = 1).
Implement parity DSU with find(x) returning (root, xor_to_root) and union(x,y,c) enforcing x xor y = c, tracking consistency and component count.
Reduce the system to H+W variables (row/column params) using prefix XORs, plus the row/column parity precondition.
Solve the bipartite cross system over H+W nodes with parity DSU, abandoning on contradiction.
Output pow(2, components, 998244353) if consistent, else 0, for each test case.
Optimize input parsing and DSU memory/time for sum HW ≤ 10^6 and T up to 10^5.
Verify against sample inputs (2,0,2) and additional edge cases.
